# Object type visual edge
<ObjectTypeMenuBreadcrumb code="itemTypeVisualEdge" />
<!--- THIS FILE IS GENERATED PLEASE DO NOT EDIT IT DIRECTLY --->

A visual edge defines a display segment only on the object type, distinct from shape points

<OH code="itemTypeVisualEdge"/>




## Required Properties {#properties-mandatory}
    
### Coordinate X1 {#x-1}

Abscissa of the first endpoint of the edge

*Technical name:* ```x1```
<PH code="itemTypeVisualEdge:x1"/>

### Coordinate X2 {#x-2}

Abscissa of the second end of the edge

*Technical name:* ```x2```
<PH code="itemTypeVisualEdge:x2"/>

### Coordinate Y1 {#y-1}

Ordinate of the first endpoint of the edge

*Technical name:* ```y1```
<PH code="itemTypeVisualEdge:y1"/>

### Coordinate Y2 {#y-2}

Ordinate of the second end of the edge

*Technical name:* ```y2```
<PH code="itemTypeVisualEdge:y2"/>

### Sort index {#sort-index}

Visual edge display order

*Technical name:* ```sortIndex```
<PH code="itemTypeVisualEdge:sortIndex"/>

    



## Associated entities (unique) {#properties-belongs-to}

### Form point (beginning) {#item-type-point-start}

An optional shape point to which the start endpoint is linked.

*Technical name:* ```itemTypePointStart```
<PH code="itemTypeVisualEdge:itemTypePointStart"/>

### Object type {#item-type}

<PH code="itemTypeVisualEdge:itemType"/>
